pieces.Text: You can attune a trap to yourself as a standard action and by making a successful Disable Device check against the trap's DC, after which the trap only triggers when you decide it can be triggered.  If the trap is attuned in a similar fashion to another creature, you must make a manifester level check against a DC of 11 + the current owner's manifester level or the attunement fails.  If the attunement is successful, you can trigger the trap as a swift action at any time in the future.  You may only have one such attuned trap at any given time.
